A naive approach would be to bid exactly $8, but that risks losing money if others bid lower. Since values are uniformly distributed between $0-$20, I'll bid slightly below my true value to create a buffer. A reasonable strategy is to bid around 70-80% of my true value, which would be approximately $5.60-$6.40.
